name: Silver Shell Events
description: Random events with a special currency, Silver Shells, that buy limited items at good rates.

phases.name: Missions
phases.description: Complete daily missions to earn points for extra rewards. A 5 USD event pass for each Silver Shell event doubles the rewards for the missions.

phases.name: Buy Silver Shells
phases.description: Buy Silver Shells from event packs.

rewards.name: Silver Shell
rewards.note: Carry over from one event to the next and stay in your backpack until you spend them in the shop

rewards.name: Custom city, march, and teleport skins
rewards.note: Old event skins you choose yourself. They cost 3,000 to 5,000 Silver Shells, depending on the event and state age. If you own every option, a city skin chest gives 100 and a march or teleport skin chest gives 20 Mythic General Hero Shards.

rewards.name: Harbor of Hope
rewards.note: Island building. 1% lethality and health for each level, up to 10% each at max.

rewards.name: Skating Rink
rewards.note: Island building. 2% research speed for each level, up to 10% at max.

rewards.name: Ski Resort
rewards.note: Island building. 3% training speed for each level, up to 15% at max.

rewards.name: Charm Design, Charm Guide, and Charm Secrets
rewards.note: Charm materials. For servers with Gen 7 heroes.

tips: The shop contents can differ with your server timeline and from one Silver Shell event to another.
Saving Silver Shells is a good idea, but you could be saving for a long time because no one knows when the next event comes.
The shop prices and packs are shown on the wiki only as images.
